highlight.title: Recognized among Snowflake's top partners
highlight.body: Viewnear is a Snowflake Premier Partner, recognized in Snowflake's CoCo Preferred Partner program. Snowflake's CoCo Global Partner Momentum lineup names 41 partners out of the more than 14,000 in its network, and Viewnear is on it alongside the global systems integrators and Big Four firms.
